label: People
desc: The immigration rate and diversity of a city, including the sub-categories of Foreign Born and Educational Attainment.

label: Location
desc: The perceived quality of a city’s natural and built environment, including the sub-categories of Weather, Safety, Neighborhoods & Landmarks, and Outdoors.

label: Promotion
desc: A city's online presence and how widely its story is shared, including the sub-categories of Google Searches, Tripadvisor Reviews, Instagram Hashtags and Facebook Check-ins.

label: Prosperity
desc: A city’s employment and corporate head offices, including the sub-categories of Fortune 500 Companies and Household Income as well as Employment Rate and Income Equality for the 2021 America’s Best Cities rankings.

label: Programming
desc: The arts, culture, entertainment and culinary scene in a city, including the sub-categories of Shopping, Culture, Restaurants, and Nightlife.

label: Product
desc: A city’s key institutions, attractions and infrastructure, including the sub-categories of Airport Connectivity, Attractions, Museums, University Ranking, Convention Center, and Pro Sports teams.
